The '''Bluefruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was used to to make [[bluefruit jam]], a favorite of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Jos Vondar]].<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>
